World's Most Scenic Highland Railway

The Kandy to Nuwara Eliya & Ella Train Guide

Winding past cascading waterfalls, cloud forests, and emerald tea estates, the Main Line railway is a bucket-list Sri Lankan experience. Compare classes and departure times below.

Kandy to Ella (Demodara) ~160 km • 6h 30m

Best Window Seat Strategy

Sit on the Right Side from Kandy to Nanu Oya for dramatic valley drops, then switch to the Left Side from Nanu Oya to Ella for sweeping southern plains vistas.

Morning Odyssey Express: 08:47 AM → 03:15 PM
Podi Menike Express: 08:55 AM → 03:28 PM
Booking Window Opens: 30 Days Prior at 10:00 AM SLST
1st Class A/C

Observation & Reserved

Plush numbered seats, air-conditioned cabin, quiet atmosphere. Windows are sealed (cannot lean out for photos).

Official Ticket Fare $10
Most Popular
2nd Class Reserved

Open Windows + Guaranteed Seat

Windows open fully for photography and fresh mountain breeze, ceiling fans, and a guaranteed numbered seat.

Official Ticket Fare $6
3rd Class

Local Unreserved

Buy on the day at the station! Lively local atmosphere with spiced vadai snacks sold through the windows.

Same-Day Station Fare $2

Your Trusted Local Partner for Exploring Sri Lanka Without Missing a Spot
